title: [Main]-TDS Amount incorrectly calculated under Tax Information Factbox if you use Applies-to ID in the Indian version.
summary: Fixed incorrect TDS amount calculation when applying payments to purchase invoices via Applies-to ID in the Indian version. The system was deducting the gross payment amount instead of the TDS base, resulting in over-deducted TDS.
key_points: Corrected calculation logic in the Applies-to ID TDS use case to properly sum applied TDS base amounts
Removed an erroneous expression that was overwriting the calculated applied amount with the gross payment amount
Bumped use-case version from 5 to 6 to ensure the corrected configuration is re-imported
TDS now calculates correctly for single and multiple applied payments
quote: Removed the erroneous expression so AppliedAmount retains the correctly summed TDS base
